values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/first_mile/get_detail?access_token=access_token&cursor=%22%22&first_mile_tracking_number=CNF731738838434210105&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: shipment_method
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The shipment method for bound orders, should be pickup or dropoff.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The logistics status for first-mile tracking number. Status could be: NOT_AVAILABLE,ORDER_CREATED,PICKED_UP,DELIVERED,ORDER_RECEIVED,CANCELING,CANCELED. NOT_AVAILABLE status means that either of the two scenarios has happened: 1. First Mile Tracking Number in the request does not exist. (e.g., wrong format) 2. First Mile Tracking Number is not yet bound with any order.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: more
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is to indicate whether the item list is more than one page. If this value is true, you may want to continue to check next page to retrieve the rest of items.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: sls_tracking_number
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The tracking number of SLS for orders/forders.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: pick_up_done
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Use this filed to indicate whether the order has been picked up by carrier.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: arrived_transit_warehouse
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Use this filed to indicate whether the order has arrived at transit warehouse.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: next_cursor
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: If more is true, you should pass the next_cursor in the next request as cursor. The value of next_cursor will be empty string when more is false.
